verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform with SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting to disable telemetry, diagnostic events, or usage tracking in LaunchDarkly's SDKs, CLI, MCP server, or web app. The only related material describes evaluation data that apps send upstream, which is the opposite of an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
